description: Get candlestick/OHLCV data for a currency pair

from.description: Start time of K-line in Unix timestamp (seconds). Defaults to to - 100 * interval if not specified

interval.description: Time interval of data points. Note: 30d represents natural month, not 30 days

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return. Mutually exclusive with from/to parameters

to.description: End time of K-line in Unix timestamp (seconds). Defaults to current time if not specified

name: cex_spot_get_spot_candlesticks
